Here is the Extended Interview: President Trump on 60 Minutes 11-8-2026 Big takeaways from Trump’s 60 Minutes interview with Ross Douthat: •  Blames midterm losses mainly on not being on the ballot, the Iran war, higher gas prices, and dislike for Israel. Says many of his voters just didn’t turn out. •  Defends the economy as “phenomenal” but admits “bad messaging” (possibly his own) kept people from feeling it. •  Says his immigration crackdown was “too tough” at times. Got credit for the border and removing criminals, but hurt by deporting workers who had been here years. Open to a deal with Democrats for some of those people. •  Not looking to escalate the Iran war. Stands by the strikes long-term (“would do it again”), says Iran is close to a deal but the election results gave them hope. •  Hinted at staff changes (Susie Wiles out, Stephen Miller in as chief of staff shortly after). •  Will “probably” endorse a 2028 successor but “not necessarily.” Mentions Vance, Rubio, and other senators as strong options. •  Plans “tremendous numbers of pardons.” Says he doesn’t expect to pardon himself, but “it’s certainly not unreasonable.” •  Asked about death and forgiveness: hopes he’s missed and hopes to go to heaven, but says he cannot forgive some enemies because he hates them. #trump #60minutes #interview #fullinterview #longervideos
